clues.text: God sent the angel Gabriel to this town in Galilee, to a virgin pledged to marry Joseph.
For Caesar's census, Joseph went up from this town in Galilee to Bethlehem to register.
When Philip told him about Jesus, Nathanael asked if anything good could come from this place.
In the synagogue of the town where He was brought up, Jesus stood and read from Isaiah's scroll.
Afraid of Herod's son ruling Judea, Joseph took Mary and the Child to live in this Galilee town.
After hearing John was imprisoned, Jesus left this town and went to live in Capernaum by the sea.
Pilate's notice on the cross, in Hebrew, Latin and Greek, named this place as Jesus' hometown.
